style: hand-painted 3D chibi collectible-doll animation matching the supplied model sheet: oversized heads, three-head-tall bodies, watercolor-gouache texture, soft flat fluorescent lighting, restrained facial acting until the supernatural reveal. Deadpan realism: no comedy music, no reaction stickers, no explanatory graphics.
stage: An ordinary small Chinese 24-hour convenience store at 4:30 AM. Checkout counter on LEFT; open floor and vertical smartphone on ring-light tripod at CENTER; low snack rack on RIGHT with a narrow visible floor patch behind it; blue pre-dawn light through the glass storefront. Real China, 2026.

characters.identity_desc: SHA-SHA, adult fashionable woman: dark skin, exact platinum-blonde braided buns, multiple metallic earrings and necklace, patterned gray jacket, pale tulle skirt, beige boots; exact model-sheet proportions
characters.voice_desc: adult female Mandarin voice, lively fast micro-influencer delivery at first; after death the same timbre becomes slightly airy but she does not realize it

characters.identity_desc: XIAO-BAI, 19-year-old night-shift clerk: very pale skin, exact short white bob, salmon-pink work jacket with silver name badge, black shorts, white boots; exact model-sheet proportions
characters.voice_desc: young clear female Mandarin voice, natural and awake, short concerned phrases

snack rack remains on RIGHT with the reveal floor patch visible behind its lower edge

no customers and no other staff appear
